title: S723 Difficulty Governance Audit

coverage.note: QuestionID count verified at 2500 across all 5 packs. DifficultyScore count also 2500. Difficulty label count is 2512 (12 extra — Packs A/E have extras in explanation/stem text; Pack D has 1 missing Difficulty field).

dcs_label_score_mapping_drift.description: Difficulty label should map 1:1 to DifficultyScore (Easy=1, Moderate-Easy=2, Moderate=3, Difficult=4, Very Difficult=5). The following drift was detected:
dcs_label_score_mapping_drift.root_cause: Difficulty label count (2512) exceeds DifficultyScore count (2500) by 12, and there are label-vs-score mismatches. 20 items labeled 'Easy' have a DifficultyScore other than 1. 71 items with DifficultyScore=2 have a Difficulty label other than 'Moderate-Easy'. These mismatches plus the 12 extra label hits produce the observed drift.

open_defects.DL-031 (difficulty inflation): Open — scoped, not remediated. ~500 items across all 5 packs systematically labeled Moderate that test Bloom's Remember/Understand (definition-match pattern). Root cause: template-rotation authoring pipeline assigned difficulty labels by position rather than by cognitive demand.
open_defects.DL-032 (case uniform difficulty): Open — scoped, not remediated. 420 items across 75 cases in all 5 scored_cases files labeled uniformly 'Moderate' with zero variance. Zero items are Easy, Difficult, or Very Difficult. Statistically implausible for a 420-item pool spanning 6 blueprint domains.

dcs_compliance_detail.label_score_alignment: FAIL — 129 items have Difficulty-to-DifficultyScore mismatches (see drift analysis above). ~20 Easy items with wrong score, ~71 Score-2 items with wrong label, ~25 Moderate items with wrong score, ~38 Difficult items with wrong score.
dcs_compliance_detail.caqs_distribution: FAIL — Distribution is severely skewed. Moderate over-represented by 18.4pp. Difficult under-represented by 21.5pp. Very Difficult completely absent (0 items vs 10% target).
dcs_compliance_detail.pack_d_missing_field: WARN — Pack D is missing 1 Difficulty field (499 vs 500 expected).
dcs_compliance_detail.pack_e_extra_hits: WARN — Pack E has 10 extra Difficulty: hits (510 vs 500 expected), likely from Difficulty appearing in explanation/stem text.

metadata_integrity_detail.reason: Pack D missing 1 Difficulty field. Packs A (+3) and E (+10) have extra Difficulty hits from non-metadata text (explanations, stems). DCS label-score mismatch affects ~129 items.

governance_stability_detail.dq_governance: STABLE — DifficultyScore count matches item count (2500). All items have a numeric DifficultyScore.
governance_stability_detail.dcs_governance: UNSTABLE — 129 items have Difficulty-to-DifficultyScore mismatches. The two-field governance model is not enforcing consistency.
governance_stability_detail.defect_tracking: STABLE — DL-031 and DL-032 are properly documented in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md with detailed scoping, root cause analysis, and detection rules.
governance_stability_detail.remediation_status: STALE — Both DL-031 and DL-032 are Open with no remediation executed. Estimated scope: ~500 DL-031 items + 420 DL-032 case items. No batch plan or execution timeline documented.
governance_stability_detail.distribution_governance: CRITICAL — 0 Very Difficult items in a pool of 2,500. This is a psychometric defect. The CAQS §6.1 target of 10% Very Difficult is completely unmet.

issues_summary: CRITICAL: 0 Very Difficult items across entire 2,500-item MCQ pool (CAQS target: 10% / 250 items)
CRITICAL: Distribution severely skewed toward Moderate (48.4% vs 30% target); Difficult at 3.5% vs 25% target
HIGH: 129 items have Difficulty-to-DifficultyScore label/score mismatches (DCS non-compliance)
HIGH: DL-031 Open — ~500 items with template-based difficulty inflation, no remediation executed
HIGH: DL-032 Open — 420 case items with uniform Moderate labeling, no calibration performed
MEDIUM: Pack D missing 1 Difficulty field (metadata integrity gap)
MEDIUM: Pack E has 10 extra Difficulty: text hits in non-metadata content
MEDIUM: Pack A has 3 extra Difficulty: text hits in non-metadata content
recommendations: P0: Author 250 Very Difficult items to meet CAQS §6.1 minimum threshold
P1: Remediate DL-031 (~500 items): recalibrate definition-match items from Moderate to Easy
P1: Remediate DL-032 (420 case items): assign genuine difficulty labels based on cognitive level, calculation complexity, and distractor deceptiveness
P2: Fix Difficulty-to-DifficultyScore mapping drift (129 items) — align labels with scores
P3: Fill missing Difficulty field in Pack D (1 item) and remove extraneous Difficulty text from Packs A/E stems/explanations
P4: Add DCS consistency validation to automated validator suite to prevent future drift
